what: Frequency responses of equaliser and low cut of an RME Babyface Pro FS in class-compliant mode, measured with sine tones on 18 November 2026.
method: A sine at half of full scale went out on USB playback 1. Output settings: on the output channel Main left (Main at -30 dB), read behind the unit at the peak meter of input 1 over a cable from XLR output 1 to XLR input 1. Input settings: on input 1, heard alone on the left headphone channel, read at the headphone meter. Per frequency the unit was asked twice 0.15 s apart (0.35 s below 40 Hz); the second answer carries the peak of that time. measured_db is the level with the setting minus the mean of the reference curves without equaliser before and after it. calculated_db is eq_response_db() of the codec for the words of the message. counted is false where the level with the setting was less than 30 dB above the noise read without tone; those points are shown but were not compared.
sample_rate_source: reported by the iPad for the USB connection; the curves fit the calculation for 48 kHz and not the one for 44.1 kHz
